hyetal.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to rain; descriptive of the distribution
   of rain, or of rainy regions.

hyetogram.translation: 降雨历时线, 雨量图

hyetograph.definition:
n. A chart or graphic representation of the average
   distribution of rain over the surface of the earth.

hyetographic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to to hyetography.

hyetography.definition:
n. The branch of physical science which treats of the
   geographical distribution of rain.
hyetography.translation: n. 雨量图法, 雨量分布学

hyetology.translation: n. 降雨量学, 降水学
